source.public_versification_note: Public and Hebrew numbering align throughout Exodus 32–34.

key_decisions.decision: Supplies contextual go for dependent land phrase while retaining bodily abundance, refusal of presence, stubbornness and potential destruction.
Reads speech as explanation of preceding response; preserves conditional instantaneous danger and undecided next action.
Takes from Horeb as the starting point for removal of adornment; preserves Horeb name rather than harmonizing to Sinai.
Preserves habitual description, repeated outside location and access for anyone seeking; does not silently identify tent with unbuilt tabernacle.
Clarifies divine speaker from verse 11 rather than treating cloud as a separate speaking agent; retains cloud position and repeated pattern.
Preserves face-to-face speech image alongside later no-face-vision claim, names Joshua and father, and retains young attendant’s continuing presence.
Keeps face idiom as presence and singular rest recipient without inserting with all of you before Moses’ plural request.
Retains all goodness, divine name proclamation and two deliberate repeated freedom-of-grace clauses without doctrinal elaboration.
Preserves categorical human vision/life limit and face image without harmonizing away verse 11.
Preserves glory, cleft, protective hand and until timing without replacing body imagery with abstract protection.
Retains contrasting hand/back/face imagery and prohibition rather than resolving into metaphorical aftereffects.
